'''Neeralli''' was a [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[General/Legends|general]] who, along with [[Orrimaarko/Legends|Orrimaarko]] and [[Panno]], led the Dressellian resistance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Neeralli was given the specific task of leading the [[Sellou Rangers]], a group of approximately 200 [[selldu]]-riding cavalry.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
